title: A subterrain's units (map/terrain/<folder>/units.json)
description: The units, items and start locations of war3mapUnits.doo.json whose position lies in this subterrain, read and written by crates/w3proj/src/terrain_objects.rs (docs/terrain-subterrains-spec.md, section 4). An entry is the flat file's entry (units.schema.json) with an optional `order` first. The file's version and subversion live in terrain.json's dooHeader, so the keys they need aren't checked here. Other keys at the top are errors there, so they are refused here too.

order.description: its index in the flat file, where that isn't its place in this file's sorted order
